title: Translate with Google Pixel Buds - Google Pixel Buds Help
text:
Translate with Google Pixel Buds - Google Pixel Buds Help

Due to the latest device launch we are expecting higher than normal contact volume. For help setting up your new Pixel Buds, review our setup guide. For general troubleshooting, explore other support articles here. 

# Translate with Google Pixel Buds

Google Pixel Buds help you translate easily with your Pixel or compatible Android phone. Follow conversations in real-time using Face-to-Face Live Translate mode, or use Explorer Mode to automatically translate ambient sounds.

To use with Google Translate, make sure you have:

- The Google Pixel Buds connected to your phone.
- A Gemini compatible Android device (The device must meet all requirements within the linked article).
- Gemini as your default voice assistant, with Live Translate permissions turned on.
- The latest version of the Google app.
- The latest version of the Google Translate app.
- An internet connection.

Google Translate works with all Gemini-optimized headphones and Android phones. Gemini on Pixel Buds requires:

- A Gemini-enabled device with Android version 6.0 or higher.
- A Google Account.
- An internet connection.

Data rates may apply. For minimum requirements, go to Get help from Google Assistant on Google Pixel Buds.

## Use Live Translate straight from your Pixel Buds

- Listening mode: Once set up, you can press and hold on your buds to instantly launch the Google Translate app in listening mode - or just ask Gemini “Hey Google, translate for me”. This enables you to continuously translate spoken language as you navigate an environment, streaming the translated audio directly into your ear. All hands free - leaving your phone in your pocket.
- Conversation mode: Start a conversation session enhanced with automatic Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) to optimize your discussion. Your speech plays aloud through your phone's speaker, while the other person's translated speech plays privately directly in your earbud.

### Using Live Translate on Pixel Buds in Listening Mode

Important: You can’t use Gemini commands during an active translation session.

#### Control your active Live Translate sessions with your voice assistant

1. Say "Hey Google, start translating" to activate your voice assistant.
2. This launches the Google Translate app on your phone in listening mode. You can move around and have voices you hear be automatically translated into your ear.
3. Double tap when done.

#### Control your active Live Translate sessions with gestures

During setup, you can customize your earbud gestures to launch Live Translate.

- Single tap: Pauses or resumes translation.
- Double tap: Exits the session.
- Remove one Bud: Translation continues. (No impact)
- Remove both Buds: Translation exits.

Learn more about using the Google Translate App.

## Switch to Conversation Mode

When you want to have a conversation with someone and need two way translation, so they can understand you as well as you can understand them, then you can seamlessly switch to conversation mode.

1. Pull out your phone and open up the translation app.
2. If you are already in listening mode, you can tap “listening mode” to switch modes to conversation Mode. Otherwise, just tap on live translate conversation mode

Once in conversation mode, your voice will be translated and shown on the phone (and optionally played out loud) while the other person’s voice will be translated and played in your ear.

#### Step 1: Ask Google Assistant to help transcribe with Google Pixel Buds

1. While you're wearing Pixel Buds, press and hold either earbud or say, "Hey Google."
2. Request assistance, such as "Ayúdame a entender inglés."

This launches Google Translate in transcribe mode listening to the language you request (English) and translating to your default language (French, German, Italian or Spanish).

Assistant queries for transcribe mode

French: Hey Google, aide-moi à comprendre l'anglais.

German: Hey Google, hilf mir, Englisch zu verstehen.

Italian: Hey Google, aiutami a capire l'inglese.

Spanish: Hey Google, ayúdame a entender inglés.

#### Step 2: Begin listening

Listen through your Pixel Buds along with the transcript on your phone. The text is read aloud after each sentence is translated.

#### Step 1: Select your languages

1. Open Translate .
2. Tap microphone Transcribe .
3. At the bottom left corner, select the language you want to listen to (supported language: English).
4. At the bottom right corner, select the language with the spoken words to be translated into (supported languages: French, German, Italian or Spanish).

#### Step 2: Begin listening

Listen through your Pixel Buds along with the transcript on your phone. The text is read aloud after each sentence is translated.

## Tips and troubleshooting

To get the best results, make sure to:

- Move closer to the audio source.
- Ask the speaker to talk louder, slower, or more clearly.
- Switch the microphone on and off.
- Check that your input or output languages are correct.
- Verify your Wi-Fi connection.
- Ensure necessary language packs are downloaded for uninterrupted offline translation.

 Requires a Google Assistant-enabled Android 6.0+ device, Google Account, and an internet connection. Data rates may apply. Translation isn't instantaneous. For available languages go to g.co/pixelbuds/help
